trigger_condition: Complete raw Diagnostic incident/lesson ledger or a preserved second independent Diagnostic learning-loop incident becomes available.
required_artifact: Versioned normalized incident rows, lesson/disposition rows, historical verdict hashes, supersession records, linked regression/conformance results.
minimum_sufficient_proof: For EPI-003, per-unit terminal/pending accounting across all stages; for CLS-001, round-trippable state/reason mapping; for DIA-001, incident → preserved verdict → lesson → invariant → conformance → proposal-only revision.
expected_effect: Re-evaluate the three rules against the unchanged E4 contract; do not rewrite historical verdicts.

trigger_condition: Re-inspectable Motherclank row-level host, scheduler, run, restore, and migration artifacts become available.
required_artifact: At least two lane bundles with host/deployment identity, revision, datastore, run IDs, stage counts, epoch/import hashes, continuity gaps, health states, and explicit loss/unknown states.
minimum_sufficient_proof: A repeat inspection or replay preserves lineage, counts, empty/blocked/no-work-due/baseline/unknown outcomes, health-plane separation, restore/epoch distinction, and lifecycle dimensions.
expected_effect: Re-evaluate continuity, provenance, run, health, baseline, history, and lifecycle rules; no inference from missing rows.

trigger_condition: The exact frozen research replay/manifest blockers become available.
required_artifact: Complete BANKAI lead/admission benchmark; complete bounded-negative benchmark; versioned source/region/family/exclusion manifest; common claim-scoped search-plan corpus.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Every lead has fetch/admission/provenance/target binding/final status; negative scope, budget, stages, stopping, gaps, and independent hit audit replay; source universe is versioned and tied to a run; plan/replay preserves aliases/localization and status accounting.
expected_effect: Re-evaluate the four rules; do not treat query volume, summaries, or incomplete denominators as proof.

trigger_condition: A second independent non-OEM collector and a second independent delivery-enabled implementation expose preserved replay artifacts.
required_artifact: Non-OEM observation/classification/event replay; independent event/outbox/attempt/ack trace with injected delivery failure and second read.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Page presence remains non-event after restart/reinspection; delivery failure leaves immutable event truth and durable failure lineage; successful delivery does not create unsupported event truth.
expected_effect: Re-evaluate event and delivery rules; OEM records alone remain one implementation family for delivery.

trigger_condition: A second independently implemented operational scoring system records separate evidence, editorial utility, novelty, and coverage propositions.
required_artifact: Versioned score outputs, component definitions, provenance, and examples where dimensions disagree.
minimum_sufficient_proof: The four dimensions remain separately stored, rendered, and auditable without one score standing in for another.
expected_effect: Reassess E2 support and candidate maturity; no automatic promotion.

trigger_condition: Independent target-bound identity and specialist-coverage cases with reviewed positive and negative outcomes become available.
required_artifact: Source-level identity evidence, relation labels, direct-hit/loose-hit distinction, complete denominators, and independent precision/recall audit.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Wrong model, category-only, manufacturer-only, sibling, and ambiguous items are excluded; valid direct target cases survive and are reproducible.
expected_effect: Reassess identity and coverage support without optimizing novelty verdicts.

trigger_condition: Normal operation produces repeated source/fact/event records with conflicts, date roles, authority permissions, and hostile fetch outcomes.
required_artifact: Immutable run-linked records for supported/inferred/conflicting/unresolved states, date roles, source tiers, blocked/anti-bot/JS-only/placeholder dispositions, and parser revisions.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Independent real runs preserve distinctions and do not promote inference, metadata, invalid bodies, or discovery-only sources into supported facts/events.
expected_effect: Strengthen or challenge existing E3 support through ordinary operation.

trigger_condition: A non-Story implementation exposes a complete finalization/output contract in normal operation.
required_artifact: Before-publication graph validation, task status/output checks, stable references, and downgrade/drop diagnostics.
minimum_sufficient_proof: No dangling graph reference survives; FOUND states contain their required structured output; inconsistent results are visibly downgraded or rejected.
expected_effect: Move beyond Story-local E2 evidence if independently reproduced.

trigger_condition: A second operational delivery corpus records workflow and signal-budget behavior over time.
required_artifact: Idempotency keys, outbox, attempts, transport result, acknowledgement/dead-letter states, volume/rate/flood/dedupe metrics, and operator-signal outcomes.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Independent delivery implementation shows no silent loss, no duplicate retry, explicit acknowledgement, and measurable flood/signal health.
expected_effect: Reassess delivery workflow and volume rules; do not count OEM subrecords as independent.

trigger_condition: Profile owners provide applicability decisions or cross-profile implementations expose the relevant contract.
required_artifact: Profile mappings, exclusions, UI vocabulary maps, lifecycle transition records, and research/collector scope boundaries.
minimum_sufficient_proof: Each profile states applicable rules, non-applicable rules, required surfaces, and state transitions without treating absence of a profile capability as a defect.
expected_effect: Refine applicability and profile interpretation before changing maturity.

trigger_condition: A future natural-duration soak and versioned conformance run complete under an identified standard/profile/exception version.
required_artifact: Soak duration, source behavior, restarts, persistence, dedupe, classification, alerts, delivery, graduation criteria, rule/profile/version IDs, exception owner and expiry.
minimum_sufficient_proof: The run is reproducible and distinguishes tests passing from soak completion; every result identifies the governing version and exception state.
expected_effect: Provide operational evidence for soak and governance reproducibility; no STANDARD_V0.1 freeze is implied.

trigger_condition: Owners review the frozen OEM official-source and literal-secret findings and produce an approved disposition.
required_artifact: Owner decision, scoped remediation or accepted exception, expiry/review date, and post-decision verification evidence.
minimum_sufficient_proof: The historical failure remains immutable while current conformance status and exception/remediation evidence are separately recorded.
expected_effect: Resolve owner-governance status; CVC does not remediate these findings.
